items: Posts are YAML files with typed blocks; the build renders, lists, and feeds them.
Reading time, RSS, sitemap lastmod and the Article schema are computed, never hand-written.
Run python3 build.py --lint before committing a post.

props.html:
Body copy is Markdown. Bold becomes the site’s medium weight, links pick up the brass underline, and paragraphs are separated by blank lines.

Lists work too:

  • One item
  • Another item
Hover a subhead to see the anchor link; clicking it copies the section URL. A subhead whose text ends in a question mark reads like an FAQ, which suits answer engines.
